description: This file defines an enumeration `AccountingRuleType` representing different types of accounting rules within the Fineract system. It provides methods for mapping integer values to enum instances and converting enum values to various data transfer objects.

classes.name: AccountingRuleType
classes.description: An enum representing different accounting rule types with associated values, codes, and descriptions. Provides utility methods for conversion and data representation.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Returns the `AccountingRuleType` corresponding to the given integer value, or null if none matches.

methods.name: toEnumOptionData
methods.description: Converts the enum value to an `EnumOptionData` object.

methods.name: toStringEnumOptionData
methods.description: Converts the enum value to a `StringEnumOptionData` object.
